A figure walks calmly forward, her steps steady and composed. The camera follows her in a stable medium shot, slightly low, keeping her centered in the foreground. She doesn't look back, nor does she quicken her pace; the lighting is realistic and natural. Just as she continues forward, a sudden, violent explosion occurs in the city behind her. Flames instantly expand within the buildings and burst outwards, orange-yellow and incandescent fireballs tumbling and spreading. The shockwave whips up debris, metal fragments, and thick smoke, spreading upwards along the streets and building facades. The intense light from the explosion quickly reaches its peak in the background, illuminating the surrounding streets, yet leaving only a slight reflection on the figure's silhouette and shoulder line. She maintains her walking pace, neither running nor dodging, nor looking back. The camera steadily follows her forward, smoke and dust swirling and falling behind her as she gradually approaches the camera. The image finally freezes on the moment she continues walking, the buildings behind her still burning and collapsing, flames and smoke slowly dissipating—a calm, powerful, and cinematic contrast.zhuanchang,
